name: opcov/phpunit
description: PHPUnit 12/13 and Pest 4/5 integration for the opcov coverage extension

suggest.ext-curl: Downloads the opcov CLI; without it allow_url_fopen and ext-openssl are used
suggest.ext-opcov: The opcov extension that collects the coverage; see docs/install.md
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required by vendor/bin/opcov-phpunit to start the test runner, and lets vendor/bin/opcov replace itself with the opcov CLI
suggest.ext-posix: Required by vendor/bin/opcov-phpunit to create its private run directory
